description: This file defines a development-only helper function 'devTryProjectCost' used to simulate project cost history data during local development. It is designed to be disabled in production and throws an error if invoked in a production environment.

methods.name: devTryProjectCost(projectId)
methods.description: An async function that simulates fetching project cost history for a given project ID. It returns mock data with dates and total costs, or throws an error if running in production.
